briefings.title: Trump’s Former Advisors Predict How His War with Iran Ends (w/ H.R. McMaster & Matt Pottinger)
briefings.tldr: Former National Security advisors H.R. McMaster and Matt Pottinger argue that the Iranian regime is fundamentally unstable and nearing collapse, advocating for a "counter-blockade" strategy while warning that a severely downsized National Security Council (NSC) risks losing the "peripheral vision" necessary for long-term competition with China.
